summary: Container apps in the one-click installer: Ghost, Nextcloud, Uptime Kuma, n8n, Gitea and Plausible CE install on a private network with companion databases, loopback-only ports and a proxied HTTPS site. New typed agent verbs create containers under agent-side guards (KD-040). Migrations 0010-0011 are additive (app_installs.app_port; app health tables, alert_rules.app_install_id); nothing is dropped. Also: OS package updates, an in-panel update notice, and app health alerts (KD-042).
